This database describes **Avery Quill**, a fictional engineer. All organizations, products, addresses, tokens, and `.invalid` URLs are synthetic test material.

## Fixture boundaries

Only Markdown files belong in this database. Facts remain in their owning files. Navigation indexes contain paths and short labels only, never copied section bodies. A growth plan records intended learning and never proves current capability or changes a role match state.
